svg.aria-label: Privacy and permissions. No listener: Null has no HTTP port and no database: it starts OMP as a child process and talks over stdio Credentials: Your /login answers go to the local omp login process, never to Null's settings or log Shortcut: Control+Space is registered by macOS with no Accessibility or Input Monitoring permission Full Disk Access: A separate choice: macOS attributes the agent's file access to Null, and the grant is broad file access, not a sandbox Signing: Permission grants follow the code signature, so an unsigned rebuild can ask again
